study_type_evidence.quote: Cohorts of five D2.mdx mice were subcutaneously injected into the back with 10 mg/kg every other day.
Muscle performance was measured in situ with a 305C-FP muscle lever system... Mice were anesthetized (isoflurane; to effect)
study_type_evidence.section: METHODS - In vivo muscle strength testing and eccentric contraction-induced injury

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: male DBA/2J and D2.mdx, 6-9 weeks of age at the start; efficacy dosing began at ~8 weeks of age
in_vivo_species.quote: Clearance pharmacokinetics and efficacy testing were conducted in male DBA/2 J and D2.mdx mice at 6-9 weeks of age.

agents.name: GsMTx4-D
agents.sequence_source: Body describes GsMTx4 only as 'a 34 amino acid peptide' and GsMTx4-D as 'a synthetic enantiomeric form of GsMTx4 made from D amino acids'; no one-letter sequence is printed in the body.
agents.group_n: n = 5 mice/time point for the pharmacokinetic cohorts; n = 10 mice/group for the six-week efficacy study
agents.group_n_quote: Cohorts of five D2.mdx mice were subcutaneously injected into the back with 10 mg/kg every other day.
agents.dose: 10 mg/kg every other day (PK study); 10 mg/kg or 1 mg/kg in the efficacy study, alternate days for 2 weeks then every 4th day for 4 weeks
agents.dose_route_quote: we performed subcutaneous injections of 10 mg/kg of GsMTx4-D into D2.mdx mice every other day to determine the accumulation (7 or 14 days) and clearance (7 or 14 days) profile
agents.pk_quote: The body gives only descriptive washout data: 'During the clearance phase all tissues showed a > 50% decrease in concentration after one week that dropped to between 12-19% of the peak concentration after two weeks. Blood concentration dropped rapidly to near 0 after injections ceased.' Peak tissue levels are stated as 'gastrocnemius and cardiac muscle achieved a ~2 uM concentration of GsMTx4-D while diaphragm approached 8 uM' with liver and kidney '> 10 fold higher'. No numeric half-life, Cmax, Tmax or AUC parameter appears anywhere in the body.
agents.pk_section: RESULTS - GsMTx4-D tissue accumulation and clearance; DISCUSSION - Pharmacokinetics

agents.name: vehicle (saline)
agents.group_n_quote: There were four study groups (n = 10 mice/group): D2.mdx treated with vehicle (saline), or GsMTx4-D at the target concentration (10 mg/kg) or at a 10-fold lower concentration (1 mg/kg)
agents.dose_route_quote: D2.mdx treated with vehicle (saline)... A group of DBA2 mice treated with vehicle served as a non-diseased control.

agents.name: Evans Blue dye (EBD)
agents.group_n_quote: mice were injected (24 h prior; n = 5 per group; i.p. injected) with Evans Blue dye (EBD)
agents.dose_route_quote: Mice were injected with Evans Blue dye (EBD) (1 mg/kg i.p.) 24 h prior to the contraction assay.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Tissue and body fluid concentrations of GsMTx4-D are shown at the different time points (n = 5 mice/time point).
concentration_time_figure.note: Concentration of GsMTx4-D in kidney, liver, heart, gastrocnemius, diaphragm, plasma and urine plotted at 7, 14, 21 and 28 days across an accumulation phase (repeat s.c. dosing) and a washout phase; it is a multiple-dose accumulation/clearance profile, not a single-dose concentration-time curve.

bioanalytical_method: Liquid chromatography coupled with tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), performed by Custom Biologics (Mississauga, Canada)
bioanalytical_quote: samples were harvested, flash frozen and shipped to Custom Biologics (Mississauga, Canada) for liquid chromatography coupled with tandem mass spectrometry analysis
notes: NO NUMERIC HALF-LIFE IN THE BODY. The '1-week half-life' appears only in the abstract ('GsMTx4-D showed a 1-week half-life when administered by subcutaneous injection over four weeks') and is therefore recorded as 'not reported in body' per the body-only rule. The body supports only qualitative washout statements (>50% decrease after one week; 12-19% of peak after two weeks; 'The long half-life of GsMTx4-D in tissues'). Peak tissue concentrations (~2 uM gastrocnemius and heart, ~8 uM diaphragm, >10-fold higher in liver and kidney) are steady-state accumulation levels from repeated dosing, not a single-dose Cmax, so cmax is left 'not reported'. The METHODS dosing list writes 'GsMTx4' where the rest of the paper writes 'GsMTx4-D' (e.g. '5 mice injected with 10 mg/kg GsMTx4, 3 times over 7 days'); these are taken to be the same administered agent. The statement that 'a single dose of 50 mg/kg subcutaneous dosing achieved ~1 uM concentration in the heart' is explicitly attributed to the authors' previous study in C57BL/6 mice, not to this work, and is not entered as a dose for this study. Note the Methods sacrifice schedule is internally inconsistent: three separate cohorts are each described as '6 times over 14 days' but sacrificed at 14, 21 and 28 days. The PEPLIFE2 header lists a 1 week half-life by LC-MS and a sequence for GsMTx4; both are database metadata and neither is supported by the article body.
